name: Rituals
tagline: Build better habits with guided ritual arcs and daily check-ins.
summary: A private, offline-first habit tracker focused on guided ritual arcs, daily check-ins, and clear progress insights.
description:
Rituals helps you build consistent habits through focused, time-bound ritual arcs instead of endless streak pressure.

Create rituals that match your life:
- Set a custom duration from 7 to 365 days
- Organize habits by morning, midday, afternoon, evening, night, or anytime
- Personalize rituals with themes, icons, categories, and notes

Stay on track every day:
- Check off habits with fast tap-to-complete actions
- See progress rings and completion summaries at a glance
- Keep momentum with milestone achievements and streak tracking

Understand your patterns:
- Review daily history in a calendar view with completion detail
- Track trends with weekly averages, active-day stats, and total check-ins
- See your best-performing ritual and habit-level completion rates

Designed for privacy and reliability:
- Offline-first by default, with no paid backend dependencies
- Local-first data storage with optional iCloud settings sync
- Clean, calm interface built for daily focus

Whether you are starting a morning routine, improving productivity, or building mindfulness habits, Rituals gives you a clear structure you can actually sustain.

name: The Noise Clock
tagline: Bold full-screen clock, calming noise, and reliable alarms in one clean app.
summary: A distraction-free digital clock with full-screen display controls, curated white noise, and dependable alarms for bedtime and focus.
description: The Noise Clock is a distraction-free digital clock built for bedside use, deep focus, and calmer nights. It combines a full-screen clock, curated noise playback, and a powerful alarm system in one clean experience.
promotionalText: The Noise Clock combines a bold full-screen clock, calming noise, and reliable alarms in one clean app. Personalize fonts, colors, glow, and schedules for focus or sleep.
highlights: Full-screen digital clock optimized for readability
Calming white, pink, brown, ambient, nature, and mechanical sounds
Unlimited alarms with labels and repeat schedules
Per-alarm controls for sound, vibration, volume, and snooze
AlarmKit-powered alerts with Live Activity countdown support
Personalized clock style with fonts, colors, glow, and display controls

description: Selfie Cam by TopDog elevates your selfies with a configurable screen-based ring light (adjustable thickness/opacity), multiple color temperatures (Pure White, Warm Cream, and premium presets like Ice Blue, Soft Pink, Warm Amber, Cool Lavender), and pro camera tools. name: BusinessCard by TopDog
tagline: Create, share, and track digital business cards with QR codes.
summary: Digital business cards with QR codes, rich profiles, dynamic contact fields, quick sharing, and iCloud sync — works on iPhone and Apple Watch.
description: BusinessCard by TopDog lets you design and share professional digital business cards instantly. Customize layouts (header styles, cover/logo/profile photos), add unlimited contact fields (email, phone, social, developer links, payment, scheduling, custom URLs), and share via QR code, link, SMS, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and more. Track who received your card and when. Full-screen card viewer, dark-themed share sheet, offline sharing toggle, and iCloud sync across iPhone and Apple Watch. Built with SwiftUI, SwiftData, and CloudKit — no ads, no tracking, beautiful and private.
